attacks.playerSkill: read and reverse a committed port-starboard firing rhythm
attacks.recognitionCue: paired eye and wing-root flares step visibly from port to starboard before each committed needle lane
attacks.telegraph: the firing-side wings brace and its authored needle mount becomes visible before the damaging needle leaves the moving muzzle
attacks.boundedVariation: seeded port-first or starboard-first order only
attacks.movementRule: cross behind each committed lane, then reverse with the alternating wing bank
attacks.recoil: the firing wing pair kicks backward around its named joints while the opposite bank catches the body
attacks.recovery: needle mounts retract, eyes dim, and all eight wings settle back to the canonical fan

attacks.playerSkill: enter and follow a rotating opening through connected shard rings
attacks.recognitionCue: the central core opens while the lower wing banks cant toward the next ring rotation
attacks.telegraph: the open core and first visible shard orientation declare the future gap before any shard becomes damaging
attacks.boundedVariation: clockwise or counterclockwise seeded rotation with a bounded initial gap quadrant
attacks.movementRule: enter the declared opening and track its single controlled rotation through the second ring
attacks.recoil: core aperture snaps back while the lower wings flare away from the emitter
attacks.recovery: core remains open briefly as a visible punish window before returning to `core.closed`

attacks.playerSkill: leave a committed corner sightline and route away from the opposite follow-up
attacks.recognitionCue: Umbra braces in one upper corner, folds its upper wing pair, and fixes the reticle before firing
attacks.telegraph: the target reticle and fully visible launcher lock before the damaging needle commits; there is no live prediction line
attacks.boundedVariation: deterministic upper-left or upper-right parity plus one opposite-corner follow-up
attacks.movementRule: vacate the locked sightline before commitment, then route away from the revealed opposite corner
attacks.recoil: launcher and core kick inward while the outer wings counter-rotate around their live joints
attacks.recovery: reticle disappears before damage ends; launcher retracts and the core becomes briefly vulnerable

attacks.playerSkill: combine the learned ram exit, alternating corner reads, and final rotating core opening
attacks.recognitionCue: the arena blacks out as all eight wings fold into a unique pursuit silhouette and Umbra dissolves through the re-entry frames
attacks.telegraph: registered materialization frames, folded anatomy, dash trail, eye/core light, and corner pose reveal the committed ram without a guide line
attacks.boundedVariation: seeded lower-corner entry, alternating corner order, and clockwise or counterclockwise final ring
attacks.movementRule: vacate the locked ram, read each physical re-entry corner, then enter the final core-declared ring opening
attacks.recoil: all eight wing mounts overshoot open while the body and core lag behind the stopped dash
attacks.recovery: core stays open and wings droop after the final ring, creating the signature punish window

phaseTwo.visibleTransformation: the core opens, eye overlays remain active longer, re-entry frames punctuate relocation, and the eight wing mounts adopt a broader hunting fan
phaseTwo.behaviorChange: wing banks coordinate with faster corner relocation and the taught core opening is combined with needle pressure
